title: PremiumLogin
description: A simple, secure, and user-friendly security plugin to prevent account theft on offline-mode servers.
body:
**PremiumLogin**
A simple, secure, and user-friendly security plugin to prevent account theft on offline-mode servers.

PremiumLogin aims to replace traditional login plugins with a clear and modern philosophy: authentication should be comfortable, easy to use, and highly secure. We achieve this by solving the biggest flaw of other login plugins—having to type your password every single time you join the server.

✨ **Key Features**
Smart IP Auto-Login: The plugin stores player IP addresses using bank-grade encryption. Players only need to enter their password once per location. If they connect from their usual home network, they bypass the login screen automatically!

Maximum Privacy & Security: Your chosen password is completely invisible to everyone. Thanks to our bank-grade encryption, not even server administrators or console logs can see player passwords.

Interactive GUI Menu: No more complex command memorization. PremiumLogin features a fully interactive visual menu for players to manage their security settings effortlessly.

💻 **Commands**
/register  - Required the very first time a player joins the server to set up their secure password.

/login  - Used to authenticate when connecting from a new or unrecognized location.

/config - Opens an intuitive, interactive GUI menu where players can visually change the plugin's language, toggle the IP auto-login feature (enabled by default), and change their password.

/version - Displays the current version of the plugin and provides useful links to contact the developer.

🐛 **Support & Feedback**
Any feedback is hugely appreciated! Whether you have feature suggestions, ideas, or need to report a bug, please join our community.

Discord: Join the official Discord here! (Note: The server is a bit of a work in progress and might look a little ugly right now, but we are shaping it up over time!): [Discord](https://discord.gg/ehj9GSQG3n)
